description_target.target_text: Two containers (bg colors BG1/BG2) each hold a blob of the same inner color IN, decorated with 2-cell TABS (IN protrusions or bg dents). A tab's TIP is a cell with four in-bounds neighbors splitting 3-vs-1 between two colors, itself carrying the minority color; its partner is the single like-colored neighbor, fully surrounded by that color. Every tab is repainted with the OTHER container's background.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  ;; Two containers (bg colors BG1/BG2) each hold a blob of the same inner
  ;; color IN, decorated with 2-cell TABS (IN protrusions or bg dents). A
  ;; tab's TIP is a cell with four in-bounds neighbors splitting 3-vs-1
  ;; between two colors, itself carrying the minority color; its partner is
  ;; the single like-colored neighbor, fully surrounded by that color. Every
  ;; tab is repainted with the OTHER container's background.
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ((h (rows g))
           (w (cols g))
           (nbrs (lambda (r c)
                   (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w))
                           (map (lambda (d) (list (+ r (first d)) (+ c (second d))))
                                cardinal-deltas))))
           (vals (lambda (ps) (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) ps)))
           (tip-at
             (lambda (p)
               (let* ((r (first p))
                      (c (second p))
                      (vs (vals (nbrs r c))))
                 (if (!= 4 (length vs))
                     (list)
                     (let ((uniq (unique vs)))
                       (if (!= 2 (length uniq))
                           (list)
                           (let* ((x (first uniq))
                                  (y (second uniq))
                                  (cx (count-if (lambda (v) (= v x)) vs))
                                  (a (if (= cx 3) x y))
                                  (b (if (= cx 3) y x)))
                             (if (or (and (!= cx 1) (!= cx 3)) (!= (at g r c) b))
                                 (list)
                                 (let ((partner (find-first
                                                  (lambda (q) (= (at g (first q) (second q)) b))
                                                  (nbrs r c))))
                                   (if (and partner
                                            (all? (lambda (v) (= v b))
                                                  (vals (nbrs (first partner) (second partner)))))
                                       (list (list r c a b partner))
                                       (list)))))))))))
           (tips (flatmap tip-at (grid-positions g)))
           (pairs (map (lambda (t) (list (third t) (fourth t))) tips))
           (colors (unique (flatmap (lambda (pr) pr) pairs)))
           (inner (find-first (lambda (col) (all? (lambda (pr) (member col pr)) pairs))
                              colors))
           (bgs (filter (lambda (col) (!= col inner)) colors)))
      (if (or (null? tips) (not inner) (!= 2 (length bgs)))
          g
          (reduce
            (lambda (acc t)
              (let* ((pr (list (third t) (fourth t))))
                (if (not (member inner pr))
                    acc
                    (let* ((own-bg (if (= (third t) inner) (fourth t) (third t)))
                           (other (find-first (lambda (col) (!= col own-bg)) bgs))
                           (partner (fifth t)))
                      (set-cell (set-cell acc (first t) (second t) other)
                                (first partner) (second partner) other)))))
            g
            tips)))))
